en: Black‑and‑white street scene showing an early‑20th‑century European city intersection with cobblestone pavement, horse‑drawn carts, a few pedestrians, and multi‑story masonry buildings. On the prominent corner building at right the sign "STADT DRESDEN" appears along the facade. Other shop signs include "Max Esche" and a grocery labeled "Kolonialwaren, Kaffee Kakao…". Overhead utility wires and a tall smokestack are visible in the background, and there is a kiosk or pillar with notices posted on it in the foreground.
